source.label: thm:dynamic-regret-one-point
source.quote: Under Assumptions 1, 2, and 3, for any $\delta>0$, $\eta >0$, and $\alpha = \delta/r$, the expected dynamic regret of BGD$(T, \delta,\alpha,\eta)$ for the one-point feedback model satisfies ... \leq \frac{7R^2 + RP_T}{4\eta} + \frac{ \eta d^2 C^2T}{2\delta^2} + \big(3L + \frac{LR}{r}\big)\delta T

results.notes: Universal dynamic regret vs arbitrary comparator sequence. Remark 1: tuning with P_T known gives O(T^{3/4}(1+P_T)^{1/4}) (not recorded separately).

symbols.R_X: radius of a ball containing X

conditions: holds for any feasible comparator sequence

source.label: thm:dynamic-regret-two-point
source.quote: Under Assumptions 1, 2, and 3, for any $\delta > 0$, $\eta>0$, and $\alpha = \delta/r$, the expected dynamic regret of BGD for the two-point feedback model satisfies ... \leq \frac{7R^2 + RP_T}{4\eta} + \frac{\eta L^2 d^2}{2}T + \big(3L + \frac{LR}{r}\big)\delta T

results.notes: Loss is average of the two queried points. Remark 2: with P_T known, O(sqrt(T(1+P_T))).

conditions: holds universally for any feasible comparator sequence
tuning: step-size pool H as in eq. (ss-pool), delta = T^{-1/4}, alpha = delta/r, meta learning rate epsilon properly set

source.label: thm:final-order-with-meta
source.quote: Under Assumptions 1, 2, and 3, with a proper setting of the pool of candidate step sizes $\H$ and the learning rate $\epsilon$, PBGD algorithm enjoys the following expected dynamic regret, One-Point Feedback Model: $O\big(T^{\frac{3}{4}}(1+P_T)^{\frac{1}{2}}\big)$; ...

results.notes: Does not require knowledge of P_T.

conditions: holds universally for any feasible comparator sequence
tuning: two-point step-size pool, delta = T^{-1/2}, alpha = delta/r, meta learning rate epsilon properly set

source.label: thm:final-order-with-meta
source.quote: ... Two-Point Feedback Model: $O\big(T^{\frac{1}{2}}(1+P_T)^{\frac{1}{2}}\big)$. The above results hold universally for any feasible comparator sequence.

results.notes: Matches the lower bound of Theorem 4.

symbols.tau: upper bound on the path-length of the comparator sequence
symbols.R_X: radius of a ball containing X

source.label: thm:lower-bound
source.quote: For any $\tau \in [0, 2RT]$, there exists a comparator sequence $\u_1,\ldots,\u_T \in \X$ satisfying Assumption 1 whose path-length $P_T$ is less than $\tau$, and a sequence of functions satisfying Assumption 3, such that for any algorithm designed for BCO with one-/two-point feedback who returns $\x_1,\ldots,\x_T$, ... \geq C\cdot dL\sqrt{(R^2 + R \tau)T}

results.notes: Holds for both one- and two-point feedback; recorded under two-point (stronger). Proof relies on static minimax lower bounds of Dani et al./Shamir; statement does not specify whether regret is in expectation (minimax value). Remark 4: holds even for strongly convex smooth functions with one-point feedback.

conditions: holds universally for any feasible comparator sequence

source.quote: Under the same conditions with Theorem 3, the anytime version of PBGD enjoys the following expected dynamic regret, One-Point Feedback Model: $O\big(T^{\frac{3}{4}}(\log T +P_T)^{\frac{1}{2}}\big)$; ...

conditions: holds universally for any feasible comparator sequence

source.label: thm:bandit-adaptive-regret-one-point
source.quote: Under Assumptions 1, 2, and 3, define the surrogate loss ... Set $\delta$ as in (optimal-delta) and $\alpha=\frac{\delta}{r}$. Then the expected adaptive regret satisfies $\mathbb{E}[{\AReg}_T]\leq\sqrt{Cd\left(15R\sqrt{T}+8R\sqrt{7\log T+5}\sqrt{T}\right)\left(3LT+\frac{LR}{r}T\right)} = O\big(T^{\frac{3}{4}}(\log T)^{\frac{1}{4}}\big)$.

results.notes: Expected adaptive regret: max over intervals [q,s] of expected interval regret vs best fixed point. Theorem 6 states the O(T^{3/4}(log T)^{1/4}) summary.

symbols.R_X: radius of a ball containing X

source.label: thm:bandit-adaptive-regret-two-point
source.quote: Under Assumptions 1, 2, and 3, define the surrogate loss ... Set $\alpha=\delta/r$ and $\delta=1/\sqrt{T}$. Then the expected adaptive regret satisfies $\mathbb{E}[{\AReg}_T]\leq Ld\left(15R\sqrt{T}+8R\sqrt{7\log T+5}\sqrt{T}\right)+3L\sqrt{T}+\frac{LR}{r}\sqrt{T}=O\big(T^{\frac{1}{2}}(\log T)^{\frac{1}{2}}\big)$.

results.notes: Expected adaptive regret. Theorem 6 gives the O(sqrt(T log T)) summary.
